pystac.Provider.url.raw_description:
Optional homepage on which the provider describes the dataset
and publishes contact information.

pystac.Item.raw_description:
An Item is the core granular entity in a STAC, containing the core metadata
that enables any client to search or crawl online catalogs of spatial ‘assets’ -
satellite imagery, derived data, DEM’s, etc

pystac.Item.add_asset.raw_description: Adds an Asset to this object.

pystac.Item.add_derived_from.raw_description: Add one or more items that this is derived from.

pystac.Item.add_link.raw_description: Add a link to this object’s set of links.

pystac.Item.add_links.raw_description: Add links to this object’s set of links.

pystac.Item.assets.raw_description: Dictionary of Asset objects, each with a unique key.

pystac.Item.bbox.raw_description:
Bounding Box of the asset represented by this item using either 2D or 3D
geometries. The length of the array is 2*n where n is the number of dimensions.
Could also be None in the case of a null geomet

pystac.Item.clear_links.raw_description: Clears all Link instances associated with this object.

pystac.Item.collection.raw_description: Collection to which this Item belongs, if any.

pystac.Item.collection_id.raw_description: The Collection ID that this item belongs to, if any.

pystac.Item.common_metadata.raw_description: Access the item’s common metadata fields as a CommonMetadata object.

pystac.Item.datetime.raw_description: Datetime associated with this item. If None , then start_datetime and end_datetime in common_metadata will supply the datetime range of the Item.

pystac.Item.delete_asset.raw_description:
Deletes the asset at the given key, and removes the asset’s data
file from the local filesystem.

pystac.Item.ext.raw_description: Accessor for extension classes on this item

pystac.Item.extra_fields.raw_description: Extra fields that are part of the top-level JSON fields the Item.

pystac.Item.from_dict.raw_description: Parses this STACObject from the passed in dictionary.

pystac.Item.from_file.raw_description: Reads a STACObject implementation from a file.

pystac.Item.full_copy.raw_description:
Create a full copy of this STAC object and any STAC objects linked to by
this object.

pystac.Item.geometry.raw_description:
Defines the full footprint of the asset represented by this item, formatted
according to RFC 7946, section 3.1 (GeoJSON) .

pystac.Item.get_collection.raw_description: Gets the collection of this item, if one exists.

pystac.Item.get_datetime.raw_description: Gets an Item or an Asset datetime.

pystac.Item.get_derived_from.raw_description: Get the items that this is derived from.

pystac.Item.get_links.raw_description: Gets the Link instances associated with this object.

pystac.Item.get_parent.raw_description:
Get the Catalog or Collection to
the parent for this object. The root is represented by a Link with rel == 'parent' .

pystac.Item.get_root.raw_description:
Get the Catalog or Collection to
the root for this object. The root is represented by a Link with rel == 'root' .

pystac.Item.get_root_link.raw_description:
Get the Link representing
the root for this object.

pystac.Item.get_self_href.raw_description: Gets the absolute HREF that is represented by the rel == 'self' Link .

pystac.Item.get_single_link.raw_description:
Get a single Link instance associated with this
object.

pystac.Item.get_stac_objects.raw_description:
Gets the STACObject instances that are linked to
by links with their rel property matching the passed in argument.

pystac.Item.id.raw_description: Provider identifier. Unique within the STAC.

pystac.Item.links.raw_description:
A list of Link objects representing all links associated with
this Item.

pystac.Item.make_asset_hrefs_absolute.raw_description: Modify each asset’s HREF to be absolute.

pystac.Item.make_asset_hrefs_relative.raw_description: Modify each asset’s HREF to be relative to this object’s self HREF.

pystac.Item.matches_object_type.raw_description:
Returns a boolean indicating whether the given dictionary represents a valid
instance of this STACObject subclass.

pystac.Item.properties.raw_description: A dictionary of additional metadata for the Item.

pystac.Item.remove_derived_from.raw_description: Remove an item that this is derived from.

pystac.Item.remove_hierarchical_links.raw_description: Removes all hierarchical links from this object.

pystac.Item.remove_links.raw_description: Remove links to this object’s set of links that match the given rel .

pystac.Item.resolve_links.raw_description:
Ensure all STACObjects linked to by this STACObject are
resolved. This is important for operations such as changing
HREFs.

pystac.Item.save_object.raw_description: Saves this STACObject to it’s ‘self’ HREF.

pystac.Item.self_href.raw_description: Gets the absolute HREF that is represented by the rel == 'self' Link .

pystac.Item.set_collection.raw_description: Set the collection of this item.

pystac.Item.set_datetime.raw_description: Set an Item or an Asset datetime.

pystac.Item.set_parent.raw_description: Sets the parent Catalog or Collection for this object.

pystac.Item.set_root.raw_description: Sets the root Catalog or Collection for this object.

pystac.Item.set_self_href.raw_description: Sets the absolute HREF that is represented by the rel == 'self' Link .

pystac.Item.stac_extensions.raw_description: List of extensions the Item implements.

pystac.Item.target_in_hierarchy.raw_description:
Determine if target is somewhere in the hierarchical link tree of
a STACObject.

pystac.Item.to_dict.raw_description: Returns this object as a dictionary.

pystac.Asset.raw_description:
An object that contains a link to data associated with an Item or Collection that
can be downloaded or streamed.

pystac.Asset.clone.raw_description: Clones this asset. Makes a deepcopy of the extra_fields .

pystac.Asset.common_metadata.raw_description: Access the asset’s common metadata fields as a CommonMetadata object.

pystac.Asset.copy.raw_description:
Copies this asset’s file to a new location on the local filesystem,
setting the asset href accordingly.

pystac.Asset.delete.raw_description:
Delete this asset’s file. Does not delete the asset from the item
that owns it. See delete_asset() for that.

pystac.Asset.description.raw_description:
A description of the Asset providing additional details, such as how it was
processed or created. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text
representation.

pystac.Asset.ext.raw_description: Accessor for extension classes on this asset

pystac.Asset.extra_fields.raw_description:
Optional, additional fields for this asset. This is used by extensions as a
way to serialize and deserialize properties on asset object JSON.

pystac.Asset.from_dict.raw_description: Constructs an Asset from a dict.

pystac.Asset.get_absolute_href.raw_description: Gets the absolute href for this asset, if possible.

pystac.Asset.has_role.raw_description: Check if a role exists in the Asset role list.

pystac.Asset.href.raw_description: Link to the asset object. Relative and absolute links are both allowed.

pystac.Asset.media_type.raw_description:
Optional description of the media type. Registered Media Types are preferred.
See MediaType for common media types.

pystac.Asset.move.raw_description:
Moves this asset’s file to a new location on the local filesystem,
setting the asset href accordingly.

pystac.Asset.owner.raw_description:
The Item or Collection that this asset belongs
to, or None if it has no owner.

pystac.Asset.roles.raw_description:
Optional, Semantic roles (i.e. thumbnail, overview, data, metadata) of the
asset.

pystac.Asset.set_owner.raw_description: Sets the owning item of this Asset.

pystac.Asset.title.raw_description: Optional displayed title for clients and users.

pystac.Asset.to_dict.raw_description: Returns this Asset as a dictionary.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.raw_description: Implementation of the Item Asset Definition Object for use as values in the item_assets dict.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.apply.raw_description: Sets the properties for this asset definition.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.create_asset.raw_description: Creates a new Asset instance using the fields from this ItemAssetDefinition and the given href .

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.description.raw_description:
Gets or sets a description of the Asset providing additional details, such as
how it was processed or created. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.ext.raw_description: Accessor for extension classes on this item_asset

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.media_type.raw_description: Gets or sets the media type of the asset.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.roles.raw_description: Gets or sets the semantic roles of the asset, similar to the use of rel in links.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.set_owner.raw_description: Sets the owning item of this ItemAssetDefinition.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.title.raw_description: Gets or sets the displayed title for clients and users.

pystac.ItemAssetDefinition.to_dict.raw_description: Returns a dictionary representing this ItemAssetDefinition .

pystac.CommonMetadata.raw_description:
Object containing fields that are not included in core item schema but
are still commonly used. All attributes are defined within the properties of
this item and are optional

pystac.CommonMetadata.constellation.raw_description: Gets or set the name of the constellation associate with an object.

pystac.CommonMetadata.created.raw_description:
Get or set the metadata file’s creation date. All datetime attributes have
setters that can take either a string or a datetime, but always stores
the attribute as a string.

pystac.CommonMetadata.description.raw_description: Gets or set the object’s description.

pystac.CommonMetadata.end_datetime.raw_description: Get or set the item’s end_datetime.

pystac.CommonMetadata.gsd.raw_description: Gets or sets the Ground Sample Distance at the sensor.

pystac.CommonMetadata.instruments.raw_description: Gets or sets the names of the instruments used.

pystac.CommonMetadata.keywords.raw_description: Get or set the keywords describing the STAC entity.

pystac.CommonMetadata.license.raw_description:
Get or set the current license. License should be provided
as a SPDX License identifier ,
or other . If object includes data with multiple
different licenses, use other and add a link for
each.

pystac.CommonMetadata.mission.raw_description: Gets or set the name of the mission associated with an object.

pystac.CommonMetadata.object.raw_description: The object from which common metadata is obtained.

pystac.CommonMetadata.platform.raw_description: Gets or set the object’s platform attribute.

pystac.CommonMetadata.providers.raw_description: Get or set a list of the object’s providers.

pystac.CommonMetadata.roles.raw_description: Get or set the semantic roles of the entity.

pystac.CommonMetadata.start_datetime.raw_description: Get or set the object’s start_datetime.

pystac.CommonMetadata.title.raw_description: Gets or set the object’s title.

pystac.CommonMetadata.updated.raw_description:
Get or set the metadata file’s update date. All datetime attributes have
setters that can take either a string or a datetime, but always stores
the attribute as a string

pystac.ItemCollection.raw_description:
Implementation of a GeoJSON FeatureCollection whose features are all STAC
Items,
as defined by STAC API - ItemCollection Fragment .

pystac.ItemCollection.clone.raw_description:
Creates a clone of this instance. This clone is a deep copy; all Item instances are cloned and all additional top-level fields
are deep copied.

pystac.ItemCollection.extra_fields.raw_description:
Dictionary of additional top-level fields for the GeoJSON
FeatureCollection.

pystac.ItemCollection.from_dict.raw_description: Creates a ItemCollection instance from a dictionary.

pystac.ItemCollection.from_file.raw_description: Reads a ItemCollection from a JSON file.

pystac.ItemCollection.is_item_collection.raw_description: Checks if the given dictionary represents a valid ItemCollection .

pystac.ItemCollection.items.raw_description: List of pystac.Item instances contained in this ItemCollection .

pystac.ItemCollection.save_object.raw_description: Saves this instance to the dest_href location.

pystac.ItemCollection.to_dict.raw_description: Serializes an ItemCollection instance to a dictionary.

pystac.Link.raw_description: A link connects a STACObject to another entity.

pystac.Link.absolute_href.raw_description: Returns the absolute HREF for this link.

pystac.Link.canonical.raw_description: Creates a canonical link to an Item or Collection.

pystac.Link.child.raw_description: Creates a link to a child Catalog or Collection.

pystac.Link.collection.raw_description: Creates a link to a Collection.

pystac.Link.derived_from.raw_description: Creates a link to a derived_from Item.

pystac.Link.ext.raw_description: Accessor for extension classes on this link

pystac.Link.extra_fields.raw_description:
Optional, additional fields for this link. This is used by extensions as a
way to serialize and deserialize properties on link object JSON.

pystac.Link.from_dict.raw_description: Deserializes a Link from a dict.

pystac.Link.get_absolute_href.raw_description: Gets the absolute href for this link, if possible.

pystac.Link.get_href.raw_description: Gets the HREF for this link.

pystac.Link.get_target_str.raw_description: Returns this link’s target as a string.

pystac.Link.has_target_href.raw_description: Returns true if this link has a string href in its target information.

pystac.Link.href.raw_description: Returns the HREF for this link.

pystac.Link.is_hierarchical.raw_description: Returns true if this link’s rel type is hierarchical.

pystac.Link.is_resolved.raw_description: Determines if the link’s target is a resolved STACObject.

pystac.Link.item.raw_description: Creates a link to an Item.

pystac.Link.media_type.raw_description:
Optional description of the media type. Registered Media Types are preferred.
See MediaType for common media types.

pystac.Link.owner.raw_description:
The owner of this link. The link will use its owner’s root catalog ResolvedObjectCache to resolve objects, and
will create absolute HREFs from relative HREFs against the owner’s self HREF.

pystac.Link.parent.raw_description: Creates a link to a parent Catalog or Collection.

pystac.Link.rel.raw_description:
The relation of the link (e.g. ‘child’, ‘item’). Registered rel Types are
preferred. See RelType for common media types.

pystac.Link.resolve_stac_object.raw_description:
Resolves a STAC object from the HREF of this link, if the link is not
already resolved.

pystac.Link.root.raw_description: Creates a link to a root Catalog or Collection.

pystac.Link.self_href.raw_description: Creates a self link to a file’s location.

pystac.Link.set_owner.raw_description: Sets the owner of this link.

pystac.Link.target.raw_description:
The target of the link. If the link is unresolved, or the link is to
something that is not a STACObject, the target is an HREF. If resolved, the
target is a STACObject.

pystac.Link.title.raw_description:
Optional title for this link. If not provided during instantiation, this will
attempt to get the title from the STAC object that the link references.

pystac.Link.to_dict.raw_description: Returns this link as a dictionary.

pystac.MediaType.raw_description: A list of common media types that can be used in STAC Asset and Link metadata.

pystac.RelType.raw_description:
A list of common rel types that can be used in STAC Link metadata.
See “Using Relation Types in the STAC Best Practices for guidelines on using relation types. You may also want
to refer to the “Relat

pystac.StacIO.raw_description:
Method used internally by StacIO instances to serialize a dictionary
to a JSON string.

pystac.StacIO.json_dumps.raw_description:
Method used internally by StacIO instances to serialize a dictionary
to a JSON string.

pystac.StacIO.json_loads.raw_description:
Method used internally by StacIO instances to deserialize a
dictionary from a JSON string.

pystac.StacIO.read_json.raw_description: Read a dict from the given source.

pystac.StacIO.read_stac_object.raw_description: Read a STACObject from a JSON file at the given source.

pystac.StacIO.read_text.raw_description: Read text from the given URI.

pystac.StacIO.save_json.raw_description: Write a dict to the given URI as JSON.

pystac.StacIO.set_default.raw_description: Set the default StacIO instance to use.

pystac.StacIO.stac_object_from_dict.raw_description:
Deserializes a STACObject subclass instance from a
dictionary.

pystac.StacIO.write_text.raw_description: Write the given text to a file at the given URI.

pystac.ExtensionNotImplemented.raw_description:
Attempted to extend a STAC object that does not implement the given
extension.

pystac.DeprecatedWarning.raw_description:
Issued when converting a dictionary to a STAC Item or Collection and the
version extension deprecated field is present and set to True .
